thread:
Maya (AE): Riverbank signed the NDA and wants a short POC to move from CompetitorX -> Redwood. They want: prompt parity, response diffs, per-1k cost delta, and security questionnaire. Can eng + security split tasks?
Cory (ML Eng): I can run the diff harness. Need a 48h redacted prompt export, median + p95 token lengths, and whether they rely on streaming hooks.
Maya (AE): They stream; peak concurrent ~520. I'll request the export and traffic histogram.
Rhea (Solutions Eng): POC plan: 1) tiny adapter proxy to translate CompetitorX requests -> Redwood API, 2) replay on sandbox pool at low QPS, 3) run golden prompt suite and comparator. I can ship the proxy.
Rhea (Solutions Eng): Adapter example (pseudo): POST /proxy -> map body.text -> {"input": body.text, "model":"redwood-medium", "temperature":0}
Cory (ML Eng): For parity runs set temperature=0 and top_p=0.0. Capture tokenizer outputs. CompetitorX applies light answer trimming — include their postproc in comparator.
Liam (Product): For pricing delta I need sequence histograms and percent streaming. I'll model hosted vs dedicated vs Private and show batching/quantization effects.
June (Security): I'll take the SQ. Need retention requirements, SSO (SAML/SCIM), KMS/BYOK ask, SIEM forwarding, and egress IP allowlist. If they require customer-managed keys, Private covers it but legal will need to see controls.
sandbox-bot: replay job queued by Rhea - job_id=20017 - ETA 9m.
Rhea (Solutions Eng): Timeline (7 business days): Days 1-2 adapter + infra, Day 3 replay + capture, Days 4-5 parity analysis, Day 6 prompt mitigations, Day 7 joint review + pricing.
Cory (ML Eng): Note: CompetitorX exposes a "seed" param for deterministic outputs. We don't expose seed publicly; we can run internal fixed-seed experiments for the POC and include results.
Maya (AE): Next steps: 1) Riverbank upload sample + SQ, 2) Rhea deploy proxy + start replay, 3) June draft SQ answers, 4) Liam + Cory prepare parity report and cost delta. Sync in 6 business days. Please ack. :thumbsup:
Cory (ML Eng): ack
Rhea (Solutions Eng): ack
Liam (Product): ack
June (Security): ack
Maya (AE): thanks — I'll share drive links and calendar invite.
